co: Solve problems based on asymptotes, partial differentiation equations, curve tracing, maxima and minima.
Know ordinary differential equations and their applications, and develop a mathematical model of linear differential equations.
Solve basic engineering models through partial differential equations such as the wave equation and heat conduction equation.

1FY1-02.title: Engineering Physics
co: Understand interference in thin films and diffraction by slits.
Understand the principle behind the working of lasers and optical fibres.
Understand the concept of quantum mechanics and one-dimensional motion of a particle.
Understand the properties of semiconductors, superconductors and nanomaterials.
Understand electric and magnetic field behaviour and derive Maxwell's equations.

rows.head: Wave Optics
rows.topics: Concept of interference, Interference in thin films (reflected light): Newton's Rings and Michelson's Interferometer, Application as wavelength measurement. Concept of Diffraction, Single slit Fraunhofer Diffraction, Diffraction Grating and Spectrum, Determination of Wavelength, Application of Grating as wavelength splitter.

rows.head: Lasers and Optical Fibers
rows.topics: Laser: Einstein's theory of laser action; Einstein's coefficients; population inversion and lasing action, Properties of laser beam, Construction and working of He-Ne and semiconductor lasers, Applications of lasers in science and engineering. rows.head: Quantum Mechanics
rows.topics: Concepts and experiments that led to the discovery of quantum nature. The free particle problem: particle in 1-dimensional and 3-dimensional boxes, Concept of quantum mechanical tunneling.

rows.head: Physics of Advanced Materials
rows.topics: Types of semiconductors, Conductivity in semiconductors, Energy Band Gap, Hall Effect: theory and applications, Superconductors: properties, Meissner effect, Type I and II superconductors, Applications of superconductors, Nanomaterials: significance of nanoscale, properties of nanomaterials, basics of synthesis (top-down and bottom-up), applications of nanomaterials, X-ray Diffraction.

rows.head: Introduction to Electromagnetism
rows.topics: Gradient, divergence and curl and their physical significance, Divergence and Curl of electrostatic and static magnetic fields, Faraday's law, equation of continuity, Displacement current, Maxwell's equations, Electromagnetic wave propagation in free space, Flow of energy and Poynting vector.

Write paragraphs and letters precisely, coherently and cohesively.
Learn the correct usage of grammar.

co: Know the essential components of the computer and working hardware devices.
Design algorithms and flowcharts for problems.
Understand the fundamentals of C programming.
Use suitable data structures and logic for problem-solving.

rows.head: Fundamentals of Computer and Number System
rows.topics: Stored program architecture of computers, Storage devices: primary memory and secondary storage, Random, Direct and Sequential access methods, High-level, Assembly and Low-level languages, hardware, software, firmware, source file, object file, translators, assembler, compiler, interpreter. Representing algorithms through flowchart and pseudocode. Number system: data representations, radix r representation with r = 2, 8, 10 and 16, conversion between radixes, r's and (r-1)'s complement, binary addition and subtraction, representation of alphabets.

rows.topics: C character set, literals, keywords, identifiers, Data types in C, ASCII code, variable declaration, expressions, labels, statements, formatted input-output statements, types of operators, associativity and precedence of operators, expression evaluation, data type conversion, mixed-mode arithmetic.

rows.head: Control Statements and Loops in C
rows.topics: If statement, nested if, if-else, else-if ladder, switch statement, conditional operator (?:), goto statement. Looping and iteration: basic iteration (initialization, steps, termination), while, do-while, for, break and continue statements.

rows.head: Arrays, Pointers and Structures in C
rows.topics: Arrays: one-dimensional, two-dimensional and multidimensional arrays with examples. Pointers: pointer arithmetic, programming with arrays and pointers, sizeof operator, memory allocation functions, array of pointers, pointers to void, command-line arguments, structures and unions in C, enumeration.

rows.head: Functions in C
rows.topics: Function basics, user-defined functions, inter-function communication (call by value, call by reference), standard functions. Storage classes: auto, register, static, extern, scope rules, passing arrays and structures to functions, introduction to recursion, recursive functions, pointers to functions.

rows.topics: Strings: concepts, C strings, string input/output functions, string manipulation functions, string/data conversion. Input and output: concept of a file, streams, text and binary files, opening and closing files, file input/output functions, file status and positioning functions.

rows.head: Rules of engineering drawing
rows.topics: Line types (centre, hidden, outline, dimension, extension, construction, leader, section, cutting-plane, break and locus lines); dimensioning types and rules; scales: enlargement and reduction, engineer's scale, graphical scale, representative fraction.
